title: Reuben and Gad's Children Ask for Gilead
description: The tribes of Reuben and Gad ask to receive the land east of the Jordan because they have much livestock, but Moses warns them not to discourage the people as their fathers did at Kadesh-Barnea. They promise to go armed at the front of Israel until the land is conquered, and Moses gives them and half the tribe of Manasseh the kingdoms of Sihon and Og as a possession. They build cities in Gilead, and Makir, Jair, and Nobah take over areas in the north.
